about: A host whose frame the displays off hold wakes for nothing (ADR 0057, decision 6: the machine silent when nothing happens). FrameProbe's Once button, once the scenario's server answers its cue (`cue_before`, never a clock of the application's own), changes what the window draws a single time. The displays are off by then for want of input (the battery's timers as held-frames': off after two minutes), so the compositor answers none of the window's frames and the one it has to draw waits. Waiting is not work: the host's loop used to count the window it could not draw as busy, arm its idle memory trim a second on at every wake, and so wake once a second for as long as the displays stayed off (the ThinkPad's shell, 15 November 2026: 1.03 wakeups a second with its panel off). Five seconds with the frame held: the host's threads are switched out a few times at most. A press brings the displays back, and the frame held shows the change.

steps.name: Once: waiting for the scenario's cue
Two minutes with no input: the displays turn off
The cue answered with the displays off: the window changes once, and the compositor answers none of its frames
Five seconds more, the frame held: the host wakes for nothing
A press on the window's empty side brings the displays back: the frame held shows the change, made once
